resources.string: Cannot open this mind map. The file or recovery copy may be damaged, unavailable, too large, or from an unsupported version. Originals have been retained.
Copy saved. The original and its recovery status are unchanged.
Delete this node and all its descendants? You can undo this operation.
The destination changed or became unreadable. This save has not overwritten it. The latest edits are in the local recovery copy. Save a copy to a new file.
Saving failed. If the recovery copy was written successfully, you can close with recovery below; otherwise keep this page open and retry or save a copy.
Recovered unsaved edits from this device. Save to commit them, or save a copy to a new file.
Document limit reached: 1,000 nodes, 128 levels, 250,000 ink points, 20,000 characters per node, or maximum paper size. Reduce the content and retry.
Mind map canvas. Use the toolbar to edit the selected node.
Tap to select · Double-tap to edit · Drag a node to move its branch · Pinch to zoom
Write with the pen; fingers do not draw. Lasso ink, then drag inside the selection to move it. Done commits edits; Cancel leaves the node unchanged.

Select a node and add a text or handwriting child, or a sibling. Double-tap to edit. Drag blank space to pan; pinch or use zoom buttons to zoom. Drag a node onto another node to change its parent. Collapse hides content without deleting it. Auto layout arranges branches on both sides. Undo restores deleted branches and ink. Files use the independent .xmap format. XMind formats and split panes are not supported. Save a copy is a complete editable backup. Recovery copies belong to this installation and are removed if app data is cleared.
